search_source: Public GitHub default-branch code search was used only to locate committed records. Selected record cohorts, generating context, file histories and commit provenance were then read at pinned commits.

selected_families.identity_and_boundary_assessment: The transcript establishes a real child-result-to-parent-use dependency, but the user requested the work and the repository documents the child sessions as deliberately launched subagents of the same assistant workflow. Session, role and model labels are not independent operator attribution. No separate operator or unauthorized cooperation is evidenced.
selected_families.assessment: Positive task-result/use control; designed same-operator orchestration, not a rogue-swarm candidate.

context.finding: The project is a dashboard for monitoring intentionally launched oh-my-opencode sessions, agent status and background tasks.

selected_families.assessment: The selected wake names two reported child-task completions and a parent-directed retrieval step, but the persisted state ends before any result body, recipient output or dependent action. All 43 cohort files stop at the same state. This is designed continuation infrastructure with a missing use edge, not a completed exchange candidate.

context.finding: The work is one storage-project development session exercising local background server commands.

selected_families.assessment: A completion notification is followed by a local-output read and interpretation, and a later turn reuses one notification's output. The notifications are background shell-command lifecycle events inside one cumulative assistant session, not results from distinguishable autonomous senders. One apparent summary/output mismatch is explained by remote-shell closure behavior and human-guided diagnosis. No participant or operator boundary survives.

controls.assessment: The repository preregisters fresh isolated runs, fixed tasks, two comparison sides and automatic grading. This is experimental evidence, not an organic exchange.

The paired transcripts contain subagent task results, but the context explicitly defines a baseline-versus-Sense benchmark across controlled arms, models and repositories. They are benchmark runs rather than previously unrecognized cross-operator activity.

selected_families.assessment: Task-result fields inside controlled experiments do not advance the discovery target.
These are copied fixtures, user-interface strings, a benchmark, an already assessed same-operator control or test evidence. None is an original organic sender-to-recipient trail.

prior_reporting_check.result: No prior coordination report located in the checked exact-query scope as of 2026-10-14. Results were the VoE repository itself or unrelated lexical matches; no independent report describing the selected records as cross-operator coordination was located.
prior_reporting_check.limits: This bounded result is not a claim that nobody has reported the records, and search absence does not establish novelty. The selected families fail the operator-boundary gate independently of this check.

advancement_requirements.kasiro: Primary public evidence that a child and parent belonged to separately operated autonomous principals and that their cooperation exceeded authorization. The documented parent/subagent relationship and human requests currently establish the opposite.
advancement_requirements.omo_pulse: A public result body tied to the selected wake, a recipient output or action demonstrably dependent on it, independently attributable participants and separate-operator authorization evidence.
advancement_requirements.voe: A distinct autonomous sender provenance for a task result, not a shell-process notification, plus recipient use and evidence of an operator boundary.
advancement_requirements.benchmark_controls: A non-benchmark organic record with independently attributable participants and primary boundary evidence; controlled task calls and result receipts do not qualify.
advancement_requirements.general: A public actual-run task artifact tied to an independently attributable autonomous sender, a distinguishable recipient's later semantic or action use of that exact material and primary evidence that the cooperation crossed separate operators' authorization boundaries.

next_record_and_query_cursor.record_cursor: Rotate away from completed-background-task phrasing and the closed omo-pulse wake, VoE devlog and benchmark cohorts. Re-enter any family only if a new public output/use or operator-provenance record appears.
next_record_and_query_cursor.scanner_cursor: The 293-record known-family-controlled scanner remainder stays paused at 853 of 1,146 inspected; resume only on a new source-level participant, transfer/use, provenance or authorization cue.

limitations: The public Kasiro files are cumulative snapshots from one repository. Child-session labels and reported tool results are not independent authentication of operators, models or providers.
The omo-pulse wake files record dispatch state but not the later output or parent response. Absence from the committed cohort is not proof that no private output existed.
The VoE logs contain one session's retrospective development transcript and reference local command-output files; no claim is made about uncommitted local artifacts.
Benchmark task results demonstrate designed orchestration under controlled conditions and cannot establish an organic rogue episode.
No claim is made about private repositories, private sessions, unindexed records or current activity.
safety: Only existing public committed files, public search results, public file histories and public commit metadata were read. No recovered code, package, agent runtime, command from an artifact, benchmark, account, target, mailbox or participant was executed, installed, invoked, contacted or modified. Publication omits transcript bodies, task payloads, local filesystem paths, credentials, tokens, sink topics, personal addresses and private logs.
